observations.behavior: Replaces a conditional check and feature-flag-dependent filtering with an unconditional filter that always excludes MANAGED_WAREHOUSE jobs.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the dependency on the 'managed-warehouse-data-modeling-shadow' flag; warehouse jobs are no longer returned by this API regardless of any future or existing flags.

observations.behavior: Adds an explicit database-level exclusion of non-CLICKHOUSE engines to the queryset. This is equivalent behavior without runtime checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes backend presentation layer behavior: warehouse-originated data modeling jobs become invisible through this endpoint unconditionally rather than being hidden only while a specific internal shadow-mode flag was active.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that warehouse-created jobs do not appear in the response results when queried via the standard job list endpoint.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the removal of managed warehouse job visibility, confirming expected behavior after removing the conditional path.

observations.limitations: The removed code relied on a private client helper (ph_client) and a named feature flag whose configuration and lifecycle are not shown. No migration or compatibility handling is visible, so potential side effects depend on external setup.

review.limitations: The removed code relied on a private client helper (ph_client) and a named feature flag whose configuration and lifecycle are not shown. No migration or compatibility handling is visible, so potential side effects depend on external setup.
review.reason: This chunk removes a bounded capability—the ability to return warehouse-specific jobs unless explicitly enabled—replacing it with unconditional filtering. The implementation and its corresponding assertion are both present; no broader systemic change across other components is demonstrated.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s warehouse ingestion and dashboard presentation layers by changing which records users can retrieve from the warehouse-related API endpoints.
review.uncertainty: Medium: without access to the ph_client and surrounding product context, we cannot assess whether this removal could break dependent consumers or migrations.
